remarks: Coastal charm meets thoughtful design in this beautifully upgraded, semi-attached single-family home with two outdoor living areas, a roomy two-car garage with charging capability and a full-size driveway! You own the land while HOA maintains the lush greenbelts! Exceptionally positioned within the complex to capture refreshing coastal breezes and enjoy a wonderful sense of privacy, this single-level residence offers comfort and style throughout. This three-bedroom home currently lives as a two-bedroom plus den/office, which can easily be converted to a third bedroom.
